scope: RoboTwin adjust_bottle expert rollout with explicit MPlib fallback
summary: The non-official MPlib arm-planning fallback failed on seeds 0 and 1, so the route is closed after two root-cause-equivalent attempts and official Curobo remains mandatory.
evidence: Seed 0 failed during batch grasp-pose planning because the fallback lacked Curobo plan_batch semantics.
After explicit routing of single and batch arm plans to MplibPlanner, seed 1 produced two left-arm path segments but then failed IK and did not complete the task.
No successful trajectory or task-success claim was produced.
lessons: RoboTwin's Curobo planner is not interchangeable with MPlib by changing the embodiment planner string; batch pose selection and constraint behavior differ.
Two failed seeds with the same IK root cause are sufficient to stop this fallback rather than spend more compute.
limitations: The fallback ignored constraint_pose and was intentionally separated from the official recipe.
Curobo v0.7.8 is not yet installed in the experiment runtime.
next_actions: Complete the pinned Curobo source/toolchain installation; do not retry the unchanged MPlib fallback.
